name: Watch Release Log
description: On the site that publishes releases, asks Sigstore once a day (every hour while something is wrong) whether the next release can still be logged on its public Rekor log. Sigstore moves to a new log about once a year and lists it months ahead; every node must be given the new log's key by a release logged before the changeover, or no release reaches any node again. Reconcile Incidents turns the answer into an incident on this node: the next log's key not yet pinned (critical in its last 30 days), any other reason a publish would be refused, or the watch itself unable to see Sigstore.
